# Design Notes: Voyage (Travel & Tourism Template)

- **Source Reference**: ColorLib Passport (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/passport/`)
- **Aesthetic**: Premium travel and tourism landing page with warm orange accent (`#fc8621`), serif headings (`Playfair Display`), and clean sans-serif body text (`Open Sans`).
- **Color Palette**:
  - Primary: `#fc8621` (Warm Orange)
  - Dark: `#212529` (Charcoal text)
  - Light: `#f8f9fa` (Off-white backgrounds)
- **Imagery**: Using deterministic Unsplash/Picsum Photos seed `https://picsum.photos/seed/voyage-<section>/<w>/<h>` for all travel photography.
- **Interactive Elements**:
  - FAQ accordion with state toggle for answers.
  - Mobile menu toggle in navigation.
  - Destination slider / card grid.
